description: Create your own automated faceless channel simply by talking with ChatGPT. This plugin writes, edits, and posts videos to your TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram accounts entirely on autopilot.

defaultPrompt: What are some trending faceless niches?
Build me a faceless channel in a trending niche that posts videos every day.
Post a faceless scary story video to my YouTube twice per day.
interface.longDescription: Create your own automated faceless channel simply by talking with ChatGPT. This plugin writes, edits, and posts videos to your TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram accounts entirely on autopilot.

name: faceless-video

positive.description: Explore available video ideas and account readiness.
positive.prompt: Show me the available video types and trending niches, their credit costs, and my current account balance.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available video types, required inputs, credit costs, plan, balance, and connected platforms without changing the account.

positive.description: Review the newest retained video using a test account with at least one video from the last 30 days.
positive.prompt: Show my recent videos and check the status and viewing link for the newest one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists videos retained during the 30-day window and returns the newest video's status, editable fields, quality, timing, and available result or CDN link.

positive.description: Start an Instagram connection and inspect its status before authorization.
positive.prompt: Start an Instagram connection and check its current status.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short-lived first-party authorization link and reports the owner-scoped request as pending without exposing provider credentials.

positive.description: Create, revise, and render a one-off AI Video using a subscribed test account with enough credits.
positive.prompt: Create a one-off Studio BTS video, rename the draft to “Behind the Magic,” then render it in Premium quality.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes and requests approval before draft creation, retrieves and renames the draft, then separately quotes and confirms Premium rendering before charging credits and returning a stable result link.

positive.description: Create and manage an automated email Series using a subscribed test account with enough credits.
positive.prompt: Show my Series, then create a daily Studio BTS email Series. Rename it to “Behind the Scenes,” switch it to weekdays, and pause it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Series, quotes the recurring cost before creation, requests approval, creates the Series, then previews and confirms the requested rename, schedule, and status updates atomically.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for an unsupported video-editing request.
negative.prompt: Change the captions and background music on my latest video.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked and should explain that caption and background-music editing are not supported.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for an unsupported billing request.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked and should explain that subscription and billing management are not available through the plugin.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for an unsupported arbitrary upload and immediate publishing request.
negative.prompt: Upload a video file from my computer to YouTube and publish it immediately.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked and should explain that arbitrary file uploads and immediate publishing of existing videos are unsupported.
